## 429. Where the possible grows (UE11)

UE, a unified explanation of reality, names self-changing conditions its deepest structural gap, and its seventh item asks how the possible grows ([plan](../../development/ue-unified-explanation/PLAN.md)). UE10 found that along a course of one fixed process nothing is added to the whole possible ([§424](424.md#424-what-a-course-keeps-reachable-ue10)), and 07's reading of it ended where a process that changes would be needed; 01's Open item left unstated a change of the law of change with no fixed law above it. UE11 reads the possible relative to what is held, on any process and on the root, and reads a rule changing its own rule and a tower of rules with no top as processes ([note](../../development/ue11-where-the-possible-grows/NOTE.md)).

**Its standing.** Every law is near-definitional or a witness: laws on the possible under a process are UE10's `Reaching.Possible.of_reach` and its iteration over a stretch, the held laws their instance at the held moves, the adaptive law theirs at the rule, and the root law an induction on reach with the tower law its instance. That the possible with what is held grows only across a change of what is held is open-ended novelty's innovation (Banzhaf and others 2016), which holds there by definition, restated as a law on any process; the tower law's finite support is, in substance, the finite degree of introspection of reflective towers (des Rivières and Smith 1984), restated on processes and on the root with its premise shown needed. No neighbour found states either as a law on any process.

**The review and the fix round.** The [review](../../development/ue11-where-the-possible-grows/REVIEW-UE11.md), with fourteen Lean probes, found every theorem of the first draft correct with an empty axiom report and asked for three changes in the module and two in the note: the top law's docstring said more than its Lean (the stronger law landed, `Run.possibleHeld_of_stays`); a sentence of the witness misstated what the held laws require; `keeping` took a word the package and the glossary use in three other senses and shadowed Branching's under `open Branching` (renamed `Reaching.heldMoves`, the two landed restrictions instances by definition, the clash check clean with the whole package); the reading needed the glossary's terms and a place beside D5 and the root's `«生生不息»`; three credits were wrong. Every required and recommended finding was taken: the located forms with a weaker decided premise, the general law over a sequence of relations growing coarser on the root and on any process, the witness that its premise is needed, the positive tower law and its gate instance, the witness that the converse fails, and a tower witness relative to every height.

**The re-check.** An independent [re-check](../../development/ue11-where-the-possible-grows/RECHECK-UE11.md) of the fix round, with nine Lean probes, found every theorem correct with an empty report and asked for five fixes to text. "The possible grows only relative to what is held" contradicted UE10's possible within a horizon, which keeps widening along a course of one fixed process; it now names the sense and claims no exclusivity. Three laws were stated without their keeps-widening premise. The reading let a whole that only returns have more still able to form, which D5 excludes, and claimed renewal without end together with growth relative to what is held without a witness. Two docstrings said more than their Lean: a move above a height need not change a rule, and holding move by move was the same as holding as at the start in one direction only. Every finding was taken, each with new Lean where the re-check offered it: a course that returns keeps nothing widening (`Run.not_keepsWidening_of_returns`), the oscillating course has the whole possible exceeding the actual and the held possible widening across a step (`Oscillating.returning_has_both`), both witnesses cease under what is held (`RaisedRule.ceases`, `CopyDown.ceases`), the rule raised at every other step has growth and renewal without end (`RaisedEveryOther.both`), and for a class the two readings of holding agree both ways, not in general (`Reach.heldMoves_iff_sameAsStart`, `AdjacentHeld.differs`, `OrderHeld.differs`). The re-check's other probes stay evidence: with each step's holding only weakly decided the change is still located, and with no decision, asked of every process, locating is weak excluded middle, a lemma of the item.

**Decisions at landing.** `Onward.within_eq_heldMoves`, `Branching.keeping_eq_heldMoves`, the laws of reach and traces under the held moves, `adaptive_keeps_rule_iff` and the root law `«及在渐粗列之相续»` (列, a sequence, since 族 is the grammar's family) stay in the leaf until the owners of the definitions they concern move them. The module imports Gated and Junctures for the gate instance and Branching's `keeping`, and searches with `Amounts.unmarked_or_marked`, already in its closure, rather than importing Reproduction. `Becoming.Alternating` is taken, so the witness with renewal without end is `RaisedEveryOther`. With UE11's core run rides SelectionPool's docstring correction, from DF's notes for UE1b's owner: `anticipates_iff` cites `Registration.web_keeps_iff`, not `Revision.web_keeps_iff`. It is one docstring line; the records citing SelectionPool are re-pointed, and their bindings are rebound to the receipt above.

**Readings** [AI reading, D45]. If the one unfolding were one stated process, nothing would be added to its whole possible along its course: what a course adds is the actual. The possible within a horizon moves with the actual, and the possible relative to what is held grows only where what is held changes; keeping it growing needs what is held to change without end. A tower of rules with no top adds nothing to its whole possible either, each of its possibilities being had with a top, the rules from some height up, held. So 生生不息, read at the whole as 生生 going on with more still able to form, not as growth (D5), needs no growth of the whole possible. More still able to form, which D5 reads as not a return, is not the whole possible exceeding the actual, nor the held possible widening across a step, since a course that only returns has both; it can be the held possible keeping widening, as on the witnesses, which no course coming back to one configuration without end has. Renewal without end and growth relative to what is held are different relations: on the first two witnesses every moment ceases under what is held, and with the rule raised at every other step both hold with every formation possible throughout.
